headline: Radhakishan Damani's top 10 stock holdings revealed
hook: Tracking the portfolio of a veteran investor
summary: Ace investor Radhakishan Damani's portfolio includes significant stakes in United Breweries, TSF Investments, and Horizon Industrial Parks. The list also features Blue Dart Express and Bhagiradha Chemicals among his top holdings by value. This disclosure provides retail investors insight into the asset allocation strategies of a prominent market participant.
why_it_matters: Provides insight into the investment strategy of a seasoned market veteran.

headline: Bhagiradha Chemicals reports SEBI dematerialization compliance for Q2 FY2026
hook: Routine compliance confirmed for Bhagiradha Chemicals
summary: Bhagiradha Chemicals has officially confirmed its compliance with SEBI dematerialization regulations for the second quarter of fiscal year 2026. This is a standard regulatory filing required for listed entities to maintain depository participant standards. Indian retail investors note this as routine procedural adherence with no direct financial impact on earnings or stock valuation.
why_it_matters: No direct financial impact on your holdings.
